## Discovery Report: Alert & Banner Visual Styles & Buttons Porting to Pendo

### Authoritative Sources Identified

#### **Formats/Components Alert** ([formats/components/src/components/alert/](formats/components/src/components/alert/))

**Variants & Modifiers** (from [alert.css](formats/components/src/components/alert/alert.css) JSDoc + rules):
- **Color variants (4 core)**: `-color-info` (default), `-color-success`, `-color-warning`, `-color-danger`/`-color-error` (deprecated aliases: `-variant-*`)
- **Surface variants**: `-inline` (pastel, no shadow) with deprecated `-without-shadow`, `-has-shadow-false` aliases
- **Deprecated**: `-variant-info`, `-variant-success`, `-variant-warning`, `-variant-error` (all functional aliases)
- **Button behavior**: Single button or first in group → primary inverse (on-color); secondary buttons → ghost (transparent border). Auto-sized to small (12px height) unless explicit `-size-*` modifier.
- **Icon glyph**: Auto-set per color; swap with `-icon-*` modifier
- **Close button**: `.pfx-close-button` positioned top-end, auto-sized to small
- **JSDoc metadata**: Lines 3–27 (spec); CSS rules: lines 97–402

**CSS Rule Structure** (lines 97–402):
- `@scope (.pfx-alert)` wrapping
- Defaults: color-info background + shadow, on-color text
- Line 232–259: `-inline` variant rules (pastel backgrounds, no shadow, status-colored icon, color-specific inline rules)
- Line 262–310: Button layout `.pfx-button:not(:has(+ .pfx-button))` (single/first) vs `:has(+ .pfx-button)` (secondary)
- Line 342–397: Warning/inline button color overrides (standard primary instead of inverse)
- Line 399–401: `-has-shadow-false`, `-without-shadow` deprecated aliases

#### **Plugins/Custom-Components Banner** ([plugins/pantoken/custom-components/src/components/banner/](plugins/pantoken/custom-components/src/components/banner/))

**Variants & Modifiers** (from [banner.css](plugins/pantoken/custom-components/src/components/banner/banner.css) JSDoc + rules):
- **Size variants**: `-size-relaxed` (default), `-size-compact` with aliases `-size-md`, `-size-sm`
- **Color variants (2 core)**: bare (unfilled), `-color-violet`, `-color-sea`
- **Button behavior**: First button in group `.button-group > .pfx-button:first-of-type` → inline primary (standard); following → inline ghost (secondary). Auto-sized to small unless `-size-*` modifier.
- **Icon**: Default `megaphone`; swap with `-icon-*` modifier
- **Heading**: Auto-styles `h1`–`h6` or `.pfx-heading:not([class*="-level-"])` as title-card typography
- **Close button**: `.pfx-close-button` positioned top-end, auto-sized to small
- **JSDoc metadata**: Lines 3–35; CSS rules: lines 67–284

**CSS Rule Structure**:
- `@scope (.pfx-banner)` wrapping
- Defaults: violet background + icon swatch
- Line 96–199: Size modifiers (`.-size-compact`, `.-size-relaxed`)
- Line 180–191: Color variants (`.-color-violet`, `.-color-sea`)
- Line 216–285: Button group layout + color overrides

#### **Pendo Renderer Architecture** ([renderers/pendo/](renderers/pendo/))

**Pipeline** (3-stage build):
1. **Source CSS**: `src/css/*.css` (7 files: button.css, card.css, chrome.css, container.css, inputs.css, text.css, vars.css)
2. **Embed**: `scripts/embed.ts` → inlines `src/css/*.css` into `src/generated/embedded.ts` as string constants
3. **Generate**: `scripts/generate.ts` → emits `generated/global.css` from build output
4. **Build**: `buildPendoCss()` in [src/build.ts](renderers/pendo/src/build.ts) composes CSS layers + transforms (scope, !important, prune, flatten, mangle)
5. **Test**: `tests/build.test.ts` validates composition, token coverage, focus ring, scope/!important behavior

**Build commands** (from [package.json](renderers/pendo/package.json)):
- `vp run embed && vp run generate && vp pack --watch` (dev)
- `vp run embed && vp run generate && vp test` (test)
- Must run embed/generate **before** test (tests read `generated/embedded.ts`)

**Layer cascade order** (from [src/layers.ts](renderers/pendo/src/layers.ts)):
1. tokens (pantoken `--instui-*`)
2. elevation
3. **container** ← alerts & banners
4. card
5. text
6. chrome
7. **button** ← button styling
8. inputs
9. vars (pendo `--pendo-*` overrides)
10. focusOutline (last for lowest !important priority)

#### **Alert Styling in Pendo** ([src/css/container.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/container.css) lines 330–450)

**Currently implemented**:
- Selector: `:scope[class*="instui-alert"][data-layout="lightboxBlank"]`
- **4 color variants**: `-info` (default), `-danger`, `-success`, `-warning`
- Token mappings: `--_alert-color` (border), `--_alert-icon` (status glyph)
- **Visual treatment**: Colored sidebar strip (left edge) + centered icon in strip
- **Icon rendering**: `::before` (empty), `::after` (mask-rendered icon centered in strip)
- **Structure**: padding calc for icon indent + box-shadow (elevation) + border-radius
- **Margins**: `margin-right/left: var(--instui-spacing-space2xs)`, `max-width: var(--pendo-embedded-width)`
- **Close button**: positioned absolutely top-end (inherited from chrome.css)

**NOT implemented**:
- ✗ **Inline/without-shadow variant** — no pastel background option
- ✗ **Button styling** — no primary/secondary/ghost treatment for embedded alert buttons
- ✗ **Inline icon color** — all use on-color icon

#### **Banner Styling in Pendo** ([src/css/container.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/container.css) lines 170–327)

**Currently implemented**:
- Selector: `:is(:scope, [class*="instui"]):not([class*="instui-alert"]):is([data-layout="lightboxBlank"], [class*="instui-banner"])`
- **2 color variants**: violet (default), `-sea`
- **Icon swatch**: `::before` (colored background square), `::after` (mask-rendered glyph)
- **Glyphs via class modifiers**: `-lightbulb` (default), `-megaphone`, `-verified`, `-checkmark`, `-poll`, `-canvas`, `-parchment`, `-mastery`, `-learnplatform`, `-igniteai`
- **Size handling**: Container query at `max-width: 30em` switches between relaxed (2rem icon) and compact (1.5rem icon)
- **Close button reserve**: `--_banner-close-button-reserve` padding calc when close button present
- **Overlay banner**: `instui-banner` class on popover/survey keeps `--_banner-shadow: var(--instui-elevation-above)`; embedded keeps `none`

#### **Button Styling in Pendo** ([src/css/button.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/button.css))

**Base** (lines 18–39):
- Selector: `:is(:scope, [class*="instui"]) ._pendo-button`
- Small height, line-height, letter-spacing, font-family
- Padding, border-width/style/radius, font-size/weight all set

**3 Variants** (lines 42–140):
- `._pendo-button-primaryButton` → primary-base (filled, hover, active, disabled states)
- `._pendo-button-secondaryButton` → secondary (outlined variant)
- `._pendo-button-tertiaryButton` → tertiary (ghost with border)

**Banner buttons** (lines 143–207):
- Selector: `:is(:scope, [class*="instui"]):not([class*="instui-alert"]):is([data-layout="lightboxBlank"], [class*="instui-banner"])`
- Primary uses **on-color treatment** (primary-inverse: `--instui-component-base-button-primary-inverse-background`)
- Secondary/tertiary use **inverse-ghost** (transparent + border)
- Uses `light-dark()` for accessibility fallback

**Alert buttons** (none currently):
- No selector targeting alerts specifically for button styling
- Alert buttons would inherit base primary/secondary/tertiary, not special "on-color" variants

### Styling Differences (Factual)

| Aspect | InstUI Alert | Pendo Alert (Current) | Required for Port |

| **Floating variant (default)** | Elevated shadow + on-color background | Sidebar strip (colored) + elevated shadow | Match shadow; background on sidebar |

```css
:scope[class*="instui-alert"][data-layout="lightboxBlank"][class*="-without-shadow"],
:scope[class*="instui-alert"][data-layout="lightboxBlank"][class*="-has-shadow-false"] {
```

**Build & verify** (in `renderers/pendo`):


**What tests check** (from [build.test.ts](renderers/pendo/tests/build.test.ts)):

- `expect(COMPONENTS)` — layer structure validation
- `expect(containerCss).toContain('[class*="instui-alert"]')` — alert selector present

**New tests needed**:
- Alert inline variant selectors present: `` `[class*="-inline"]`, `[class*="-without-shadow"]` ``
- Alert button styling for single/first: `._pendo-button:not(:has(+ ._pendo-button))`
- Secondary button ghost treatment: `:has(+ ._pendo-button)`
- Warning alert standard primary (not inverse) token substitution

### Constraints & Gotchas

1. **@scope root selector rule** (from repo memory): Bare compound selectors don't match `@scope` root; must use `:is(:scope, [class*="instui"])` or selector silently no-ops in scoped build.

2. **Selector formatting**: Tests use `toContain()` on raw CSS; line wrapping by oxfmt breaks assertions. Keep guards like `:not([class*="instui-alert"])` early on same line (see existing banner selector pattern).

3. **Fixed Pendo DOM structure**: Cannot add/remove sidebar strip or change icon container structure — must use `display: none` or CSS overrides on pseudo-elements.

4. **Generic icon painter hijack**: Any class containing substring `-icon-` (e.g., `._pendo-icon-info`) gets the global `[class*="-icon-"]::before` painter applied, rendering a solid square if `--pantoken-glyph` is unset. Existing `--_alert-icon` token approach is safe.

5. **Layer specificity**: Button styling in `instui.button` layer must beat banner `instui.button` rules via selector specificity or media query targeting. Pendo banner rule uses `:not([class*="instui-alert"])` guard; alert rules must be separate selector without that guard, later in same file.

6. **Token availability**: All `--instui-component-alert-*-background-inline`, `--instui-color-icon-info`, etc. must be present in the `--instui-*` token layer (sourced from pantoken tokens). Verify in published tokens before porting.
